common.premiumHelp:
Price calculation rules:
1. Preferably use mid-market price (bid+ask)/2
2. If no bid/ask, use Deribit mark_price
3. If still no data, use single-side quote bid or ask

Data filtering rules:
1. Filter out single-leg options with spread_ratio > 0.5 (bid-ask spread exceeds 50% of mid)
2. Filter out combos with premium < $10 (avoids deep OTM options)

disclaimer.title: Risk Disclosure & Disclaimer
disclaimer.p1: All strategy scan results, win-rate estimates (PoP), Kelly position suggestions, and margin calculations displayed by this tool are for educational and research purposes only and do not constitute investment advice.
disclaimer.p2: Options trading involves high risk and may result in total loss of principal; selling options (especially naked strangles and other unprotected strategies) can theoretically lose more than the principal.
disclaimer.p3: Data is sourced from Deribit's public API and may contain delays or errors; probability models are based on implied volatility assumptions and do not represent future actual results.
disclaimer.p4: By using this tool, you acknowledge that you understand and assume all trading profits and losses.

csp.title: Cash-Secured Put (CSP)
csp.description: Strategy: Cash-secured short put — if price drops to target, acquire the asset at a discount; if not, keep the premium

cc.title: Covered Call (CC)
cc.description: Strategy: Covered short call — if price rises to target, sell at a premium; if not, keep the premium

strangle.title: Strangle
strangle.description: Strategy: Same-expiry OTM Put + OTM Call combo. Long vol bets on a big move; short vol bets on range-bound consolidation
strangle.shortWarning: ⚠️ Theoretically unlimited loss; tail is RND 5% expected shortfall estimate

ironcondor.title: Iron Condor
ironcondor.description: Strategy: Same-expiry short OTM Put spread + short OTM Call spread, four-leg combo — collect premium if price stays in range, protected legs cap losses on both sides

calendar.title: Calendar Spread
calendar.description: Strategy: Sell near-term + buy far-term at same strike — time-value arbitrage exploiting faster near-term theta decay; better under backwardation

vol.title: Volatility Panel
vol.description: SVI implied vol surface + DVOL history — IVP/IVR tell if IV is rich or cheap; term structure shows contango/backwardation; skew via rr25
vol.rr25Note: RR25 = Risk Reversal (25Δ Call IV − 25Δ Put IV); positive = Call rich. BF25 = Butterfly (center kurtosis)
vol.noData: No SVI surface data yet. Run ETL to fit.

scenario.title: Scenario Analysis (Spot Shock · MTM)
scenario.note: BS revaluation (assumes IV/term unchanged); actual gap events typically spike IV, magnifying short losses
